title: C trust-anchor store stub + NVS persistence of runtime anchors
description: Follow-up from viku.2 (Python reference landed). Two parts: (1) C stub of the trust-anchor store for Zephyr (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap or security): raw Ed25519 anchors first; X.509 DER parsing is mbedTLS-dependent and can be a guarded stub until viku.6 picks a C TLS stack. (2) NVS persistence for runtime-added anchors — the Python store is in-memory; runtime anchors added via /.well-known/trust-anchors SHOULD survive reboot in all three implementations (mirror the TrustStore persistence protocol in python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py and slot_claim_settings.c patterns).
